request_user:
Fact: integration_means
What to find: Technical means for integrating the model (usage instructions, APIs, serving frameworks, prompt/chat format).
Card sections that often contain it: How to Use, Quickstart, Usage, Deployment

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: No Jinja chat template; a Python reference prompt-encoding implementation (encoding.py in the encoding folder) is provided, plus deepseek-recipe (Rust libraries with Python bindings) for production prompt encoding/parsing of Messages, Chat Completions and Responses API requests. Local inference instructions (weight conversion and running) are in the inference folder. Recommended sampling: temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95 or 1.0.
quotes: This release does not include a Jinja-format chat template. The [`encoding`](encoding/README.md) folder contains a self-contained Python reference implementation (`encoding.py`) with test cases for multi-turn conversations, tool calling, thinking mode, numeric reasoning effort, mid-conversation system messages, and interleaved image content.

For production use, we additionally release [deepseek-recipe](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-recipe), a set of Rust libraries with Python bindings that provides the same prompt format as a maintained, protocol-aware toolkit.
Please refer to the [`inference`](inference/README.md) folder for instructions on weight conversion and running inference locally.
